nodes.name: SessionFileMetadata.md
nodes.summary: Frontend UI audit of TurnMetadataFooter's resource/edit/development metadata rows, the Kanban modified-file search input, and paged Session Blame history, applying the repository's manual design-system, token, accessibility, and duplication-check dimensions.

nodes.name: SessionProvenanceHooksPanel.md
nodes.summary: Frontend UI audit of the rewritten SessionProvenanceHooksPanel (Data Sources 'Hooks' tab), covering new hook-platform rows for Trae/OpenCode, lazy per-signal diff-patch expansion, and clickable session navigation; flags a duplicated SourceIcon as a deferred cross-file sweep candidate.

nodes.name: SessionRoundMessageFooter.md
nodes.summary: Frontend UI audit of the new shared MessageFooter component (timestamp + copy button) and its integration points across the agent chat message block, chat item, stream event, and activity router, confirming design-token reuse with no arbitrary styling.

nodes.name: SpotlightSelectorContextMenus.md
nodes.summary: Frontend UI audit of the native right-click context menu added to SpotlightItemRow and its Copy Name/Copy Path value builders across worktree, branch, repository, folder, and saved-workspace palettes, noting one applied abstraction that centralizes the menu builder.

nodes.name: WorkspaceOverviewPanelView.md
nodes.summary: Short frontend UI audit of WorkspaceOverviewPanelView.tsx after the Agent Blame workspace tab was removed, confirming the remaining Overview/Details/Session tabs still use the shared TabPillItem and TabPill contract with no arbitrary styling.

nodes.name: WorktreePalette.md
nodes.summary: Frontend UI audit of the BranchPalette worktree Spotlight palette, documenting one applied fix (removed a redundant 'Current' pill that duplicated the shared selection indicator) and confirming reuse of shared pinned-action and path components.
